settings.name: Matcha & Crumb
settings.tagline: Stone-ground matcha and bread from our oven, every morning.
settings.hero_title: Ceremonial matcha. Warm bread. Made to order.
settings.about:
We started Matcha & Crumb in our tiny kitchen with one bamboo whisk and a secondhand oven.
Our matcha is stone-ground ceremonial grade, whisked fresh for every cup. Our breads are proofed overnight and baked before sunrise, so the melonpan is still warm when you pick it up.
settings.announcement: Matcha melonpan is back! Limited trays every morning.
settings.address: Maginhawa St, Teachers Village, Quezon City
